- PHL means two accounts. Pellow Home Living (Mid-Atlantic home goods, Sofia's retail account) and Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows). Filtering "PHL" returns both.
- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark (Retail) on 16 Feb 2026.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That label needs to change to Pellow Home Living.
- In the 17 Feb thread, Sofia said she would relabel the saved retail view and Kwame said he would fix the terminal view. Neither has been confirmed as done in this channel.
- Open question for June: has the saved report been relabelled, and is the Covey & Lark name still live anywhere?

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

Note on the PHL label confusion:

- PHL means two accounts. The Pellow rows are Pellow Home Living, the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments (Sofia's retail account). The Pellucid rows are Pellucid Harbor Logistics, the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark (Retail) on 16 Feb 2026.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That label needs to change to Pellow Home Living.
- In the 17 Feb #coastal-team thread, Sofia said she would relabel the saved retail view and Kwame said he would fix the terminal view. Neither has been confirmed as done in that channel.
- Open question: has the saved report been relabelled, and is the Covey & Lark name still live anywhere?

Sent via assistant on behalf of Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll (#coastal-team).
